description: This Java class named DataSeeder is responsible for populating the database with sample notes data during application startup in non-production environments. It implements the CommandLineRunner interface, so its run method executes automatically when the application starts, inserting predefined Note objects into the NoteRepository if it is empty. The class is annotated to activate only when the 'prod' profile is not active.
